findings.quote: add a case that the final phase calls `srv_process_account_deletions` on the service client once per tick and reports its integer result
findings.problem: DESIGN §11 Phase 3 acceptance lists 'cron idempotent under concurrent invocation' and DESIGN §8 says the tick is 'Idempotent under concurrency'. No G14 step proves it: 6.3a only checks the phase is called and returns 0 on a second sequential run; 6.3b only tags failures. Two overlapping Vercel cron/publish invocations double-sending pushes or double-processing deletions would go unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add to 6.3a Build 2: 'Concurrency proof (DESIGN §11 acceptance): (a) `apps/web/src/lib/cron/tick.concurrency.test.ts` — run `runTick` twice concurrently (`Promise.all`) against a mocked service client whose `srv_claim_notifications` hands each queued row to exactly one caller and whose `srv_process_account_deletions` returns 1 then 0; assert every notification is dispatched once and `processed` counts sum to 1; (b) SQL: in `11_account_deletion.sql` assert `srv_process_account_deletions` marks rows with a single `update … where processed_at is null and scheduled_for <= now() returning …` (or `for update skip locked`) by inspecting `pg_get_functiondef`, and add the same `for update skip locked` assertion for `srv_claim_notifications` (it is 3.6a's guarantee); record the result in `docs/CHECKLIST_SECURITY.md` row "cron idempotent under concurrency" (new row) and HANDOFF.' Add a done_when line for it.
